data.name: Reyansh
data.gender_notes: Reyansh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Ray of light; part of the sun
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ravi, 'sun', + aṃśa, 'part, ray' — 'a ray of the sun'. Its root is Sanskrit ravi + aṃśa. A modern popular Indian given name. Reyansh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Ray of light; part of the sun”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reyansh expresses “Ray of light; part of the sun”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ravi, 'sun', + aṃśa, 'part, ray' — 'a ray of the sun'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Reyansh total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
